name: Text Summary Options
description: Provide additional options for Long text with summary widget
project_description:
This module provides site builders with additional options for the 'summary' field when using "Text Area with a Summary" widget.

 Often, a summary or teaser field is used when displaying content in views. Drupal already has built in support for a summary field, however there is not much control of whether or not it is display, or required.

 The four main options are:

 
 Show summary: Always show the summary field 
 Summary help text: Customize the summary help text 
 Summary Placeholder: Customize the summary placeholder 
 Mark Summary as required: Only necessary with core <8.8. See: [#1704864]
